outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics tissue image with cluster overlays, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotations, not a quantitative plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows H&E images and spatial expression maps (spot-level heat-colored images), not a summary plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment line plots (running enrichment score curves), which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from Seurat FindMarkers differential expression analysis (a single computed statistic per gene, with associated p-values, not a mean of biological replicates); no error bars are shown and there is no set of individual replicate measurements to overlay, so individual data points are not applicable here.
